text:
todd: Quick sync — we need to finalize latency contract check-in for Enterprise tier across eu-west and us-west. Proposed: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms, availability 99.9%. Also need CB thresholds and fallback variant behavior. Who can weigh in?

anita: Sounds reasonable. small clarification: p95 400ms is per-request (first-token) not per-token, right?

kevin: per-request (start->first-token). that's what traces and our SLO pipeline currently measure. streaming first-token matters for UX.

caroline: For circuit breaker, prefer a hybrid rule: trigger if rolling p95 > 700ms for 5m OR error_rate > 1% for 1m. When triggered, route to fallback model variant (we usually do 80/20 shift to fallback for 5m then reassess).

todd: hybrid trigger makes sense. we should define clear cooldown and escalation steps. also need API semantics: does the routing policy API accept boolean OR groups?

kevin: DSL sketch that covers this (very rough):

```json
{
  "policy_name": "enterprise_latency_cb",
  "conditions": [
    {"group": "or", "predicates": [
      {"metric": "p95_ms", "window": "5m", "op": ">", "value": 700},
      {"metric": "error_rate", "window": "1m", "op": ">", "value": 0.01}
    ]}
  ],
  "action": {"type": "fallback", "variant": "quantized-lt-2x", "traffic_shift": "80/20", "hold": "5m", "cooldown": "10m"}
}
```

anita: UX note: console should show a live preview of which routes and customer scopes will be affected by this policy plus an estimated cost delta for the fallback variant. Sales/CS ask for that when enabling fallbacks for enterprise customers.

kevin: telemetry-wise we should emit a synthesized "slo_shortfall" signal that reduces alert noise (weighted score combining p95 gap and error_rate). then routing decider can use score > 0.6 to trigger policies instead of raw metrics.

caroline: +1. Also include metadata annotations so rollouts show owner, runbook link, and automatic rollback threshold if downstream quality drops (e.g., rerank quality delta > 3 points).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout created by todd at 2245678901, policy "enterprise_latency_cb" applied to eu-west, us-west. Status: running.

todd: Next steps: kevin to draft formal DSL + mapping to telemetry (today EOD), anita to mock the console preview and cost delta (tomorrow), caroline to propose rollback/escalation steps and runbook. reconvene 09:30 PT tomorrow.

kevin: on it, I'll post the DSL PR and a short simulation that shows triggers for a few synthetic traces.

anita: I'll add a small mock to the routing console board and link the figma.

caroline: added checklist to the ticket with rollback playbook. thanks all.
